anomaly_label: Jumpy heater (H702, H706, H704, H708) power

evidence.observation: Before the abrupt transition, reboiler temperature was 307.883 °C.
Over the last 120 s, T701 fell to 280.967 °C; T702, T704, T706 and T708 also fell, while T705 rose from 90.363 to 96.034 °C, indicating a multichannel departure from the preceding stable regime.
PDI702 increased from 1.983 to 3.356 mbar, coincident with reflux and distillate flows falling to 0.082 and 0.084 L/h.

PDI702 partially recovered to 2.515 mbar, flows recovered to 0.125 and 0.164 L/h, and system pressure remained near its prior range at 697.165 mbar; these observations do not identify a specific fault.

args.missing_evidence: Protocol phase and heater/control-command logs are needed to determine whether this transition was intended; independent temperature and pressure checks would distinguish a physical disturbance from measurement error. Product composition and the separation target are needed to assess separation.
